fields.name: Lemma
fields.description: The lemma this sentence is linked to. You can change this to link the sentence to a different lemma.
fields.guidance: If changing the lemma, ensure the new lemma's language matches the sentence language. Changing the lemma will clear any selected Meaning or Surface Form—you'll need to reselect them if needed.

actions: Verify the updated link still accurately represents the sentence-lemma relationship
Review and update Meaning or Surface Form selections if the lemma changed
Check that the link type still correctly categorizes the relationship
